definitions.full: H6972. quts קַ֫יִץ noun masculine Jer 8:20 summer, summer-fruit (compare Greek Θέρος in both meanings); — absolute ׳ק Gen 8:22 +; קָ֑יִץ Amos 3:15 +; suffix קֵיצֵךְ Isa 16:9 ; Jer 48:32 ; — 1 summer-season, opposed to חֹרֶף Gen 8:22 (J), Amos 3:15 ; Zech 14:8 ; Psa 74:17 ; || קָצִיר Jer 8:20 ; Prov 6:8 ; 10:5 ; 26:1 , also (without קָצִיר ) 30:25 ; as fruit harvest Isa 28:4 ; time of drought Psa 32:4 (figurative). 2 summer-fruit 2Sam 16:1-2 , Amos 8:1-2 , Jer 40:10 , 12 also, || בָּצִיר , 48:32 ; Micah 7:1 (in simile), but || קציר Isa 16:9 (assimilated to ק of קַיִץ ; read probably בציר ). קִיצוֺן see קצץ
